design_principles: Universal capability vocabulary for applicable humans, AI agents, robots, and software systems.
One stat represents one distinct observable construct; avoid synonym duplication.
A score requires reproducible evidence from a trusted evaluator.
Unrated and not_applicable are distinct from zero.
Stats are independent from XP, level, age, consciousness, personhood, and spiritual worth.
No stat represents or measures a divine attribute.

scoring.evaluator_gate: Trusted evaluator only; evaluated system cannot authorize its own score.

migration.legacy_mapping_policy: Do not assume ordinal equivalence between old Asmaul Husna labels and these universal stat meanings. Preserve legacy data and migrate by stable slot number only after explicit compatibility review.
